title: Nikiendesha baiskeli kuzunguka Tokyo, niligundua kuna mito na madaraja mengi sana
label: Tokyo kwa baiskeli

text.I was just riding a bike around Tokyo, t: Nilikuwa nikizunguka Tokyo kwa baiskeli tu, bila mpango wowote.
text.While riding around, what I thought was: Nilipokuwa nikizunguka, nilifikiria jinsi Tokyo ilivyo na mito na madaraja mengi.
text.The Yamanote Line trains in Tokyo are re: Treni za Yamanote Line huko Tokyo ni ndefu sana, zaidi ya mara mbili ya treni za chini ya ardhi za Nagoya
text.Walking in Ginza, I felt that Tokyo's ar: Nilipotembea Ginza, nilihisi maeneo ya Tokyo yanaenea zaidi kuliko ya Nagoya
